title: Hemoglobin (hb)
description: This test is used to measure hemoglobin concentration to evaluate anemia and oxygen transport.

title: Aspartate Aminotransferase (SGOT)
description: This test is used to measure AST enzyme levels to assess liver and muscle injury.

title: Alanine Aminotransferase (SGPT)
description: This test is used to measure ALT enzyme levels to assess liver cell injury.

title: Total Bilirubin
description: This test is used to measure total bilirubin to assess liver function and hemolysis.

title: Direct Bilirubin
description: This test is used to measure conjugated bilirubin to evaluate hepatic excretory function.

title: Alkaline Phosphatase (ALP)
description: This test is used to measure ALP levels to assess biliary obstruction or bone disorders.

title: Total Protein
description: This test is used to measure total protein levels to assess nutritional and liver status.

title: Triglycerides
description: This test is used to measure triglyceride levels to assess metabolic and cardiovascular risk.

title: Total Cholesterol
description: This test is used to measure total cholesterol to assess cardiovascular risk.

title: HDL Cholesterol
description: This test is used to measure HDL levels to evaluate protective cholesterol.

title: LDL Cholesterol
description: This test is used to measure LDL levels to assess atherosclerotic risk.

title: Urea
description: This test is used to measure creatinine levels to evaluate kidney function.

title: Serum Creatinine
description: This test is used to measure uric acid levels to assess gout and metabolic disorders.

title: Uric Acid
description: This test is used to measure sodium levels to assess fluid and electrolyte balance.

title: Serum Sodium
description: This test is used to measure potassium levels to assess cardiac and neuromuscular function.

title: Serum Potassium
description: This test is used to measure calcium levels to assess bone and metabolic function.

title: Serum Calcium
description: This test is used to measure fasting blood glucose to screen for diabetes.

title: Fasting Blood Glucose (FBG)
description: This test is used to measure postprandial glucose to assess glucose tolerance.

title: Postprandial Blood Glucose (PPBG)
description: This test is used to measure random blood glucose to assess glycemic status.

title: Random Blood Glucose (RBS)
description: This test is used to measure bleeding time to assess platelet function.

title: Bleeding Time
description: This test is used to measure clotting time to assess coagulation pathways.

title: Clotting Time
description: This test is used to determine blood group based on A and B antigens.

title: Blood Group
description: This test is used to determine Rh factor status.

title: HIV test (Antibodies 1 and 2)
description: This test is used to detect hepatitis B surface antigen indicating active infection.

title: Hepatitis B Surface Antigen (HBsAg)
description: This test is used to detect hepatitis C infection.
purpose: Charge for Hepatitis B Surface Antigen (HBsAg)

title: Hepatitis C Virus Antibody (HCV)
description: This test is used to screen for syphilis infection.
purpose: Charge for Hepatitis C Virus Antibody (HCV)

title: RPR/VDRL test for Syphilis
description: This test is used to calculate the cholesterol ratio to assess cardiovascular risk.
purpose: Charge for RPR/VDRL test for Syphilis

title: Malaria Parasite Test (MP)
description: This test is used to detect malaria parasites in blood.

title: Widal
description: This test is used to detect O antibodies against Salmonella typhi.

title: complete blood count (CBC)
description: Blood test measuring RBC, WBC, hemoglobin, hematocrit, and platelets

title: Liver function test (LFT)
description: Blood test measuring liver enzymes, bilirubin, and proteins to assess liver function

title: Lipid profile test (LPT)
description: Blood test measuring cholesterol and triglyceride levels

title: Kidney Function Test (KFT)
description: Blood test measuring kidney function markers such as urea, creatinine, and electrolytes
